_password_note: Every user below shares the plaintext password Password123!. SecurityConfig.passwordEncoder() is a BCryptPasswordEncoder(12) (src/main/java/com/app/common/security/config/SecurityConfig.java:302-303). BCrypt embeds a random salt per call, so re-encoding the same plaintext twice yields different hash strings, but a single precomputed hash string can be reused verbatim on every user row: PasswordEncoder.matches() re-derives the salt from the stored hash itself, so one fixed hash verifies correctly against Password123! for all 90 rows. The implementation phase should compute this hash once (e.g. via a throwaway BCryptPasswordEncoder(12).encode("Password123!") call, or reuse the DevDataSeedServiceImpl pattern of calling the injected PasswordEncoder bean at seed time rather than committing a hash literal to this file) and apply it to every user_credentials.password_hash row.
_avatar_note: avatar_url values below are literal, deterministic, externally-hosted portrait photography URLs from randomuser.me (https://randomuser.me/api/portraits/{men|women}/{0-99}.jpg) - 200 distinct real photographs, no API key, no rate limit. Assignment is positional (alternating men/women by array index, sequential portrait index per gender bucket), so it is stable across seed runs as long as users.json's array order does not change, and every one of the 90 users gets a distinct photograph. Avatars are no longer sourced from R2/media_assets. banner_media_ref is unaffected and still resolves against media_manifest.json's banners array via UserSeedWriter (banner_url is resolved from the manifest's cdn_url at insert time); only the 15 creator/small_business persona users (p03_photographer_freelance, p05_shop_owner_clothes, p07_fnb_owner) carry a banner.
